remarks: Completely transformed while maintaining its original character, this beautifully renovated village home offers the perfect blend of rustic warmth and modern convenience. From the moment you step inside, you'll be drawn to the impressive great room featuring rich natural wood walls and ceilings, updated flooring, abundant natural light, and a sleek electric fireplace that creates a warm and inviting gathering space. The spacious layout flows seamlessly into the updated kitchen, offering ample cabinetry, workspace, and room for entertaining family and friends. The home features multiple bedrooms and two full baths, including a stunning second-floor owner's retreat complete with a spa-inspired bathroom featuring a jetted soaking tub, custom tiled walk-in shower, and modern finishes rarely found in homes of this era. Thoughtful renovations throughout provide the comfort and functionality today's buyers are looking for while preserving the charm and craftsmanship of a classic village property. All new electrical, plumbing, siding, roof, windows,doors, floors, kitchen, baths..everything! Outside, enjoy relaxing on the covered front porch overlooking the neighborhood, a perfect place for morning coffee or evening conversations. The generous village lot provides room to enjoy outdoor activities, gardening, or future possibilities. Conveniently located in the heart of Machias, you'll appreciate easy access to schools, parks, shopping, and local amenities while remaining just a short drive from Ellicottville, Holiday Valley, HoliMont, state forests, hiking trails, and year-round recreation. Whether you're searching for a full-time residence, weekend retreat, or investment opportunity, this move-in-ready property delivers space, character, and extensive updates in one attractive package.
